scope: Targeted primary-method checks for the joint source experiment and its failure analysis, not 100 full-text reviews.

records.title: MT3: Meta Test-Time Training for Self-Supervised Test-Time Adaption
records.read_scope: Method sections 2.1-2.2, algorithms 1-2, source initialization and per-instance reset; introductory comparison to joint training.
records.experiment_link: Motivates a differentiable outer gradient to the recipient encoder, not merely fitting a reconstruction head.
records.boundary: BYOL/image adaptation, not a tokamak reproduction or an EAST performance guarantee.

records.title: DocTTT: Test-Time Training for Handwritten Document Recognition Using Meta-Auxiliary Learning
records.read_scope: Introduction, sections 3.1-3.3, algorithm 1 and ablation table 5; CVF PDF retrieval failed, author preprint used.
records.experiment_link: Jointly prepare shared features and an auxiliary objective through adaptation, then evaluate the primary task after the update.
records.boundary: Its image SSIM objective and OCR results do not validate masked diagnostic completion or precursor mechanisms.

records.title: Disruption prediction for future tokamaks using parameter-based transfer learning
records.read_scope: Primary indexed Methods text: Labeling and Weight calculation. Direct publisher open was blocked by redirect; not claimed as a fresh complete read.
records.experiment_link: Class-weight control and distinction between precursor events and disruption alarm labels.
records.boundary: The present sampler-prior importance weighting is computed from TRAIN's actual sampling distribution, not copied numerical settings.

records.title: Integrated deep learning framework for unstable event identification and disruption prediction of tokamak plasmas
records.read_scope: Primary institutional indexed abstract only; full PDF retrieval again returned 502.
records.experiment_link: Motivates studying event information alongside risk; not proof that adding a categorical auxiliary loss is sufficient.
records.boundary: Manually named unstable events in that study are not equivalent to this project's A-F algorithmic clusters.

records.title: Autonomous Discovery of Disruption Precursor Event Chains in Tokamak Plasmas via Progressive Multiple-Instance Learning
records.read_scope: IAEA conference abstract and author listing; event scheduled for November 2026.
records.experiment_link: Event sequence, potentially reversible transitions and weak supervision are relevant to state-conditioned feedback.
records.boundary: Conference abstract, not a verified full methods paper or an independently validated physical cause taxonomy.

records.title: Training on the Future: A Delay-Aware Audit of Test-Time Adaptation for Time-Series Forecasting
records.read_scope: Primary preprint abstract/introduction this round, causal release section in the preceding review.
records.experiment_link: Observed-window updates affect only subsequent immutable predictions; forecasting error is not interchangeable with risk performance.
records.boundary: Recent forecasting preprint, not a tokamak result; output correctors are not adopted as neural risk adaptation.

records.title: Horizon-Aware Early Event Prediction for Tokamak Disruption Alarms
records.experiment_link: Useful distinction between prediction horizon, censoring and operational event evaluation.
records.boundary: Within-device preprint with a different warning deadline and dataset; no claim that its soft labels are already adopted or applicable unchanged.
